name: io.github.mgcrea/mcp-apple-calendar
title: Apple Calendar
description: Search, read and act on Apple Calendar — ranges, free-time lookup, writes off by default

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_CALENDAR_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing — an agent with writes off cannot see them.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_CALENDAR_CALENDARS
environmentVariables.description: Restrict every read and write to these calendars, by name.
